mission: Produce an evidence-backed XC7S50 toolchain that can select, run, and stop reverse-engineering experiments while remaining understandable and steerable by a human.

human_interface.promise: One command reports what is known, what is not known, why work stopped, and the single highest-value next experiment.

goals.goal: Build and preserve a portable XC7S50 Frontier Grade flow from HDL through bitstream.
Make the clocking and serializer primitives needed by a real HDMI path faithful in nextpnr-xilinx.
Turn scarce Vivado runtime into an autonomous experiment loop that selects information-rich work instead of accumulating undirected artifacts.
Preserve enough evidence, intent, and reopening conditions that work survives machine, model, and human-memory changes.
Let humans steer by intentions and consequences while machines inspect exact artifacts and execute repetitive verification; neither interface may discard the other.
Fit one machine and limited storage/attention by keeping only artifacts and experiments with consequential information value.

claims.question: Does the intended BUFIO, BUFR, OSERDESE2 and differential-output chain survive implementation for every seed specimen?
claims.statement: All six seed configurations route and retain BUFIO, BUFR, at least one OSERDESE2, and OBUFDS cells.
claims.scope: xc7s50csga324-1; Vivado 2025.2; widths 8/10; BUFR divides 1/2/4; fixed pins in gold/hdmi-serializer/top.xdc
limitations: Passing implementation does not establish clean DRC or nextpnr equivalence.
The six cases are a targeted seed domain, not full primitive coverage.
claims.stop_when: The parent may use this chain as a routable Vivado reference for the stated domain.
claims.reopen_when: A retained artifact disappears, a case stops routing, pins/device/version change, or nextpnr requires a distinction outside this scope.

claims.question: Does width 10, rather than BUFR division, distinguish the MASTER/SLAVE cascade topology?
claims.statement: Within the seed domain, DATA_WIDTH=10 has two placed OSERDESE2 cells while DATA_WIDTH=8 has one, independently repeated at BUFR divides 1, 2, and 4.
claims.scope: Same seed domain; this certifies observed implemented topology, not the complete legal OSERDESE2 domain.
limitations: The RTL explicitly generates the slave at width 10; this demonstrates Vivado preserves and places the topology, not that Vivado inferred it.
Width 14 and SDR configurations remain untested.
claims.stop_when: Both sides have repeated witnesses across the nuisance BUFR_DIVIDE variable.
claims.reopen_when: Testing inferred primitives, width 14, SDR, another OLOGIC site, or a different device family.

claims.question: Is the seed serializer programming clean enough to serve as an unquestioned golden reference?
claims.statement: The implemented serializer cases have no AVAL-70 OSERDES tristate-programming warning.
claims.scope: The six current seed DRC reports.
limitations: A warning is not a routing failure, but retaining an unexplained warning would make later feature differences ambiguous.
claims.stop_when: A paired experiment identifies a warning-free configuration without changing the data serializer topology, or proves the warning unavoidable for the intended configuration.
claims.reopen_when: Vivado, primitive parameters, or tristate usage changes.

claims.question: Does changing only the unused tristate serializer rate from DDR to BUF remove AVAL-70 while preserving the width-10 topology?
claims.statement: The existing DDR control contains AVAL-70; the paired TQ=BUF specimen routes with two OSERDESE2 cells and does not contain AVAL-70.
claims.scope: Paired width-10, BUFR-divide-1 specimens on xc7s50csga324-1 with all parameters and constraints except DATA_RATE_TQ held fixed.
limitations: This isolates the warning and topology, not every emitted configuration bit.
A later nextpnr comparison must still test functional and FASM equivalence.
claims.stop_when: The paired outcome is classified once; no full matrix is required to choose the clean unused-tristate convention.
claims.reopen_when: The design begins using tristate serialization or a target requires DATA_RATE_TQ=DDR.

experiments.change: For one width-10/divide-1 specimen, change only DATA_RATE_TQ from DDR to BUF while retaining TRISTATE_WIDTH=1 and unused T outputs.
experiments.cost: One Vivado implementation plus comparison against an existing control.
experiments.expected_information: Distinguishes a parameter inconsistency from topology/routing problems and removes a known confound before expanding the corpus.

outcomes.routes_without_AVAL_70: Adopt BUF for unused tristate serialization and regenerate only specimens whose later claims depend on clean DRC.
outcomes.AVAL_70_remains: Reject the parameter-only explanation and inspect the emitted OSERDES properties before generating more combinations.
outcomes.implementation_fails_or_topology_changes: Preserve DDR corpus as qualified evidence and investigate the exact changed cell properties; do not expand the matrix.

experiments.stop_after: Stop after the paired result is classified; do not launch a full Cartesian sweep.
